channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: About five thousand Vermonters have lost SNAP benefits due to recent federal changes. The Vermont Foodbank reports increased demand at food shelves. Local media are tracking the ongoing impact on food assistance programs.
A Springfield man was arrested after a disturbance at a restaurant last month. He faces additional charges for allegedly assaulting police during his arrest. Authorities continue their investigation.

Killington officials say they've supplied all documents requested by the Vermont Economic Progress Council about the town's tax increment financing district. The TIF district funds infrastructure projects like roads and waterlines for the Killington Forward initiative. Town leaders acknowledge staffing shortages but are working with contractors to resolve accounting issues before a November nineteenth meeting.

The number of Vermonters experiencing homelessness declined for the second straight winter in twenty twenty-six. This report was released Monday. The trend shows a decrease in homelessness across Vermont.
